data.narrative:
ABL Bio is a publicly listed biotech company on KOSDAQ that has raised over $5B in total capital including licensing agreements. The valuation universe comprises 10 peers across Biotech & Health: 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 7 private firms including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, New Limit, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Two standard triangulation methods do not apply to this target. Peer-Median analysis fails due to insufficient narrow-stage filtering—while 7 same-sector peers exist, zero meet simultaneous criteria for stage, adjacency, and valuation tier; relying on all-sector medians would introduce unacceptable noise. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot proceed because ABL Bio's revenue is not disclosed, preventing application of the sector P/S median of 7.4x observed across the 3 public comparables.

Without applicable quantitative methods, a defensible triangulated valuation range cannot be derived from the available data. The analysis identifies critical missing inputs: ABL Bio's current revenue, recent profitability or burn metrics, and narrower peer comparables at equivalent maturity and platform stage. For a public company, standard equity research approaches (DCF, precedent transactions, analyst consensus) would typically anchor valuation; these fall outside the provided dataset. Further disclosure or primary research is required to support a specific range.
